If you process personal data linked to individuals in the UAE, the law may apply even without a local entity.

Key issues:

• consent-centric lawful basis
• no broad legitimate interests fallback
• cross-border safeguards
• breach readiness

Cloud ≠ compliance.

Legal bases, DPOs where required, processing records, transfer safeguards, breach readiness.

It applies.

• consent-centric lawful basis
• no broad legitimate interests fallback
• cross-border safeguards

Cloud ≠ compliance.

author: biytelum.bsky.social
text:
UAE’s PDPL has been in force since Jan 2022, with regulations issued in 2023.

Over 4 years later, many companies still think a website policy equals compliance.

It doesn’t.

Legal bases, DPOs where required, processing records, transfer safeguards, breach readiness.
